root_idea.summary: The supplied lexical evidence centers on wakefulness and the alert attention that accompanies it.
root_idea.development: The attested range extends from waking or being awake to vigilance and mental alertness, with derived causative and reflexive uses and a few specialized extensions.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quranic plural أَيْقَاظ is presented under the supported singular adjective citation form يَقِظٌ.

senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrence is the plural أَيْقَاظ, describing people who appear awake even though they are asleep in the surrounding passage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To wake or be awake; not to sleep.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form I verb, distinct from the adjective citation form represented by the Quranic plural.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rouse a person's attention toward a matter or affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extended use concerning attention rather than literal sleep.
A reported extended usage; one cited authority treats the wording as a mistranscription for بَقَّطَ التُّرَابَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become awake or to wake from sleep.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An inchoative or reflexive Form V construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become attentive, vigilant, wary, or cautious.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extended use in which attention becomes roused toward a matter or a sound.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an anklet or other ornament, to make a sound or sounds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized extended usage applied to the sound of an ornament.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Vigilant, wary, cautious, and alert in mind; mentally sharp and intelligent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extended adjectival use for roused attention and alertness. It also occurs in the comparative expression أَيْقَظَ مِنْهُ, “more vigilant or cautious than him.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: A state of waking or being awake.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal noun or simple substantive denoting wakefulness.
